title: Uzungumzaji Katika Sherehe (Theme 11: Haki za kibinadamu)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans what to say, listens to the end, and replies on the topic in standard Kiswahili with the features of a sherehe.
steps: Reply on the topic with a reason.
Keep the language and the turn-taking right.

board.do: sherehe ya kuhitimu darasa la tisa
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child takes part in a short sherehe on the topic while a partner ticks the checklist.

misconceptions.repair: Anza kwa itifaki: mgeni rasmi kwanza, kisha wengine.

misconceptions.ask: Hii ni sherehe ya aina gani?
Ni maneno yapi si ya Kiswahili sanifu?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia Kiswahili sanifu katika mazungumzo rasmi.

checks.question: Unatoa hotuba katika sherehe. Unaanza vipi?
checks.answer: Mheshimiwa mgeni rasmi, walimu, wazazi na wanafunzi wenzangu, hamjambo?

checks.question: Ni ujumbe upi unafaa katika sherehe ya kuhitimu?
checks.answer: hongera na heri katika masomo yajayo
